youtube_title: Back Pain After 9 Hours At A Desk? It's Not Your Chair | Body Fix #35 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #35. Chair from 10 AM to 7 PM... and now your back's LOCKED?
B is right. Get up and move every 30-60 MIN. Your body hates sitting still for hours.
Same position for hours = stiff muscles. The best posture is the NEXT one.
Fix: Walk during calls, screen at eye level, a few stretches daily.
Red flags: Pain down the leg with numbness, after a fall, fever or trouble peeing? DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Back pain / sitting
